data.content: This site does not collect any personal data via forms. Only audience measurement cookies (Google Analytics 4) are used, subject to your explicit consent.

basis.content: The processing of browsing data is based on your consent (Article 6.1.a of the GDPR). You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your cookies.

cnil.heading: Complaint to the CNIL
cnil.content: If you believe that the processing of your data constitutes a violation of the GDPR, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL: www.cnil.fr

what.heading: What is a cookie?
what.content: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device when you visit a website. It stores information related to your browsing.

used.heading: Cookies used on this site
used.content:
umai_consent: consent cookie, duration 13 months, records your acceptance or rejection choice.
_ga: Google Analytics cookie, duration 2 years, unique identifier for visit statistics.
_gid: Google Analytics cookie, duration 24 hours, unique identifier for session statistics.

manage.heading: Managing your cookies
manage.content: On your first visit, a banner offers you to accept or reject cookies. Your choice is recorded for 13 months. To change your choice, delete your cookies via your browser settings: the banner will reappear on your next visit.

google.heading: Learn more about Google Analytics
google.content: Google Analytics is an audience measurement tool provided by Google. To learn more about how Google manages your data: https://policies.google.com/privacy

scope.heading: Purpose and Scope
scope.content: The website umai-ramen.fr is an informational showcase website. It does not offer direct online sales. Food orders are placed via third-party platforms (Uber Eats, Gusty) which have their own terms and conditions.
